rows.raw: @The_monster@ shouts @at_foe@, "You are a heretic and must be destroyed!"
@The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "You will make a fine sacrifice."
@The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Right in the middle of my sermon, too."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“偏偏赶在我布道讲到一半的时候。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "The wages of sin are death, you know."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“你知道的，罪的工价乃是死。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ whispers @to_foe@, "I'll spare you if you take my job."
rows.zh: @The_monster@低声说 @to_foe@：“你要是肯接我的班，我就饶你一命。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ whispers @to_foe@, "Deep inside, it's sometimes so empty."
rows.zh: @The_monster@低声说 @to_foe@：“在内心深处，有时是那么空虚。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "The wrath of @my_God@ will be yours."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“@my_God@的怒火将会降临到你身上。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Your suffering will cleanse you of your heresy."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“你的苦难会洗清你的异端之罪。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "A dead adventurer is a good adventurer." @player_only@
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“死的冒险者才是好冒险者。”@player_only@

rows.raw: @The_monster@ shouts @at_foe@, "It's the end of the party!"
VISUAL:@The_monster@ becomes larger for a moment.

rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“阿尔加塔克斯·内特拉诺赫·德尔特克斯。”
@The_monster@喊道 @at_foe@：“恩特拉姆·莫斯·德格·乌拉格！”

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ jumps up and down with excitement.
VISUAL:@The_monster@ picks up some beetles from the @surface@ and offers them to you.
@The_monster@ says, "Isn't this more fun with friends?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“有朋友一起不是更好玩吗？”

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ picks up a beetle and eats it.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@捡起一只甲虫吃了下去。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ summons a swarm of flies.
VISUAL:@The_monster@ opens @possessive@ mouth, as if shouting.
VISUAL:@The_monster@ gives you the thumbs up.
VISUAL:@The_monster@ says something you can't hear.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@说了些什么，但你没听见。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ jumps up and down, looking for your attention.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@蹦蹦跳跳，想引起你的注意。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ says something but you don't hear anything.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@说了些什么，但你什么也没听到。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ smirks at the air and says, "Can't catch me!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@冲空气得意地笑，说道：“你抓不到我！”
VISUAL:@The_monster@对着空无一物的地方大笑。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ chortles and stares into space.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@咯咯笑着，瞪着虚空发呆。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ wonders, "What am I doing in here?"

rows.zh: @The_monster@尖叫道：“反正我还是要杀了你！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ @_shouts_@, "Wait for me, @player_name@! Could you help me?"
VISUAL:@The_monster@ [almost|nearly] stumbles in trying to escape.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@在试图逃跑时[几乎|差点]被绊倒。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ @_begs_@ @to_foe@, "Why can't we all just get along?"
@The_monster@ shouts @at_foe@, "No! I'll never do that again!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@喊道 @at_foe@：“不！我再也不干那种事了！”
@The_monster@[哭诉|哭喊]道：“[妈妈呀|爸爸呀|咩咩咩|救救我呀呀呀|咿咿咿呀|噢不不不不|哇啊啊啊]！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ @_begs_@ @to_foe@, "Please! I have a lot of children!"

rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@看起来[很不安|吓呆了|吓僵了]。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ looks desperately for an escape route.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@绝望地寻找着逃跑的路线。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ hums to @reflexive@ desperately, trying to keep calm.
rows.zh: @The_monster@拼命地对@reflexive@哼唱，努力保持镇定。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ tries to recover @possessive@ lost courage.
@The_monster@ says happily, "You and me, we're family."
rows.zh: @The_monster@开心地说：“你和我，我们是一家人。”

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ cocks @possessive@ head sideways at you.
VISUAL:@The_monster@ gnaws at a bone — where's that from?
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@啃着一根骨头——这是从哪儿来的？

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ seems to be having trouble coordinating @possessive@ many legs.
VISUAL:@The_monster@ flutters around in erratic circles.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@毫无规律地转着圈扑腾。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ runs around in a circle.
SOUND:@The_monster@ buzzes around in tight circles.
rows.zh: SOUND:@The_monster@嗡嗡地绕着紧小的圈子飞。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ boasts, "I have defeated monsters you have never seen."
rows.zh: @The_monster@吹嘘道：“我打败过你见都没见过的怪物。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "My insurmountable tactics guarantee your defeat."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我不可战胜的战术保证你会失败。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Are you willing to die fighting? I was!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你愿意战死吗？我可是愿意的！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ laughs, "And you think you're capable of finding the ORB? I had it, you know. Then I gave it away so I could steal it AGAIN."
rows.zh: @The_monster@大笑道：“你还以为自己能找到宝珠？告诉你，我拿到过它。后来我把它送了出去，好再把它偷回来一次。”

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ holds @possessive@ blade at the ready.
@The_monster@ says, "Live by the sword, die by the sword."
@The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Your head on a pike would complement this floor nicely."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“你的头插在长矛上，会把这片地面点缀得相当不错。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Your head would complement my pike nicely."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“你的头会把我这杆长矛点缀得相当不错。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Do you have an apple? I have a shot I want to try."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你有苹果吗？我有一箭想试试。”

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ whirls a spectral sling over @possessive@ head.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@在@possessive@头顶抡着一把幽灵投石索。
VISUAL:@The_monster@[费力地装填|毫不费力地装填]@possessive@武器。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ glances around for something to throw.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@四下张望，想找点东西扔出去。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ tries to blend into @possessive@ surroundings.
VISUAL:@The_monster@ whispers something so quietly that you cannot hear @objective@.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@低声说了些什么，轻得你听不见@objective@。

rows.raw: VISUAL:For a moment, you lose track of @the_monster@.
rows.zh: VISUAL:有那么一瞬间，你跟丢了@the_monster@。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ whispers, "Be very very quiet, I'm hunting @player_genus_plural@." @player_only@
rows.zh: @The_monster@低语道：“非常非常安静，我正在猎捕@player_genus_plural@。” @player_only@

rows.raw: VISUAL:For a moment, @the_monster@ blends into the shadows.
rows.zh: VISUAL:有那么一瞬间，@the_monster@融入了阴影之中。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "You can hit me, but you can't hurt me."
@The_monster@ says, "I have spells for any situation."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“任何情况我都有法术应对。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I am proof that knowledge is power."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我就是知识即力量的证明。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I practised a lot since I died."

rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@眉头紧锁，专心凝聚法力。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ pulls a quokka out of @possessive@ cap.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@从@possessive@帽子里掏出一只短尾矮袋鼠。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ flickers in and out of reality.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@的身影在现实中忽明忽灭。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ is wreathed in a cloud of translocational energy.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@被一团移位能量环绕着。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I love the smell of burning flesh."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我爱极了人肉烧焦的味儿。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Would you like to be cremated?"
@The_monster@ says, "Don't worry, you'll be warm in a moment."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“别担心，你马上就会暖和起来。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "A minor scratch like that one is certainly harmless."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“像那样的小擦伤当然是无害的。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "It doesn't matter if you kill me. You'll still die."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“你杀不杀我都没关系。你照样得死。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Don't move, or the poison will kill you faster."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“别动，否则毒会更快要了你的命。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "I don't need to breathe anymore, but you do!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“我已经不需要呼吸了，可你还需要！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "This is what relying on the gods got me."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“这就是信赖众神给我的回报。”
@The_monster@冷笑道 @at_foe@：“你的神现在在哪儿呢？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ mutters, "So much for the promised afterlife."
@The_monster@ says, "Form is emptiness; emptiness is form."
VISUAL:@The_monster@ briefly looks inexplicably like a @_form_@.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@有一瞬间莫名其妙地看起来像@_form_@。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ briefly turns into a @_form_@ and back.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@有一瞬间变成了@_form_@，随即又变了回来。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Look on my works and despair!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“看看我的造物，然后绝望吧！”
@The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“我的造物会比你活得长久。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "I shall send you to the shadows!"
@The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Just let the darkness consume you."
@The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "I walk in shadow, and soon so shall you."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“我行走于阴影之中，很快你也会一样。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "In life, I might have healed you instead."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“若我还活着，我或许会医治你。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I thought violence couldn't solve anything, but it solved me."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我曾以为暴力解决不了任何问题，可它解决了我。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ muses, "Killing is much more fun than I thought it would be."
rows.zh: @The_monster@若有所思道：“杀戮比我原以为的有趣多了。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ moans, "Why did I trust plants to save my life?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@哀叹道：“我当初怎么会指望植物来救我的命？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "I can no longer spread life, but I can still bring your death!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“我已无法散播生命，但我仍能带来你的死亡！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "You will make such fine fertiliser."
@The_monster@ says, "Life goes in cycles. In a little while, you'll be reborn as a tapeworm."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“生命循环不息。过不了多久，你就会转生为一条绦虫。”

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ waves a bulging coin purse at you.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@朝你晃了晃一个鼓鼓囊囊的钱袋。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I guess you can't buy your way into a good afterlife."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“看来花钱也买不来一个美好的来世。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I burned twice as bright, and look where it got me..."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我燃烧得比谁都要亮，看看这把我带到了何处……”

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ droops like a melted candle.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@像一支熔化的蜡烛一样瘫软下去。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Ashes to ashes... so for me, and next for you!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“尘归尘……先是我，接下来就是你！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I was going to become a lich, but this is almost as good."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我本打算变成巫妖的，不过现在这样也差不多。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ screams at @foe@, "You cannot imagine the pain and torment in store for you!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@冲@foe@尖叫：“等着你的是无尽的痛苦与折磨，你根本想象不到！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ screams at @foe@, "You haven't seen true ruin and despair yet!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@冲@foe@尖叫：“你还没见识过真正的毁灭与绝望！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "You would make a fine zombie."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“你会成为一个不错的丧尸。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I won't need demonic support against you."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“对付你，我不需要恶魔助阵。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I died to destroy people like you for fun."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我死，就是为了毁灭你这种人取乐。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Destruction is an occupation beyond life."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“毁灭是一份超越生命的营生。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "First you will suffer, then you will die."
@The_monster@ boasts, "I survived the Crucible of Flesh! I fear nothing now!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@夸口道：“我活着走出了血肉熔炉！如今我无所畏惧！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ tells you, "The cards don't hold a good future for you."
rows.zh: @The_monster@告诉你：“牌面里没有你的好未来。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "I will deal out your death!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“我来给你发一手死亡的牌！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I was once a great warrior, and I still am!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我曾是一名伟大的战士，现在依然是！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Ah, a second chance to prove myself in battle!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“啊，又一个在战斗中证明自己的机会！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "You're just another problem to be solved."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你不过是又一个待解决的问题。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "You're really going to get a charge out of this one."
@The_monster@ says, "Spells? Hah! My gadgets will show what real magic is!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“法术？哈！我的小装置会让你见识见识什么叫真正的魔法！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I sacrificed my body for ultimate power!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我为终极的力量献祭了自己的身体！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I'll show you the great annihilating truth!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我会向你展示那伟大的湮灭真理！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ tells you, "None of this matters. None of this is real!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@告诉你：“这一切都毫无意义。这一切都不是真的！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "First you will suffer, then you will die."
@The_monster@ says, "Death is but another step down the path of knowledge."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“死亡不过是求知之路上的一步。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I have plenty of time to study, now."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“如今我可有的是时间研习了。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ threatens, "I'm fresh out of hellfire, but you will end anyway."
rows.zh: @The_monster@威胁道：“我的地狱火用完了，但你还是会完蛋。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "The agents of utter destruction are not stopped by death."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“彻底毁灭的代理人们不会因死亡而停下。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ boasts, "After taking care of you, I will research a spell that consumes the world."
rows.zh: @The_monster@夸口道：“收拾完你，我就去研究一个吞噬世界的法术。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ threatens, "Do not fail me, O fires of Iskenderun!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@威胁道：“别让我失望，伊斯坎德伦的火焰！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "You lack the discipline to defeat me."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“你缺乏击败我的那份修为。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Let's see how well you move."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“让我们看看你的身手如何。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I'm much more flexible now that I'm not limited by flesh."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“脱离了血肉的束缚，我现在灵活多了。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "I died poor and in vain, but not as a freak."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“我死得贫穷又徒劳，但至少不是个怪胎。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "For all the tithing, I expected a more glorious afterlife than this."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“交了那么多什一税，我本以为来世会比这荣耀些。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ @_wails_@, "What do you have that I didn't have?"

rows.zh: @The_monster@一字一顿地慢慢说道：“没有希望了。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ @_wails_@, "They lied to you. The Dungeon just goes down and down forever."
rows.zh: @The_monster@ @_wails_@：“他们骗了你。地牢只会一直往下、往下，直到永远。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ @_wails_@, "You must not succeed where I failed!"
@The_monster@ whispers @to_foe@, "There is no future for you."

rows.zh: @The_monster@低声说：“永恒的寂静在等着你……”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ whispers, "Death doesn't hurt. What you feel is life."
rows.zh: @The_monster@低声说：“死亡并不痛苦。你感受到的是生命。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ whispers, "You will understand me better in a moment."
rows.zh: @The_monster@低声说：“再过一会儿，你就会更理解我了。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ whispers, "It is all a dream - a grotesque and foolish dream."
rows.zh: @The_monster@低声说：“这一切都是一场梦——一场荒诞而愚蠢的梦。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ whispers, "Soon you will have time, lots of time..."
rows.zh: @The_monster@低声说：“很快你就会拥有时间，大把大把的时间……”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ @_wails_@, "You must not fail where I succeeded!"
VISUAL:@The_monster@ yawns, and then pretends @subjective@ didn't.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@打了个哈欠，随后假装@subjective@什么也没做。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "It is my duty to kill you, but also my pleasure."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“杀了你是我的职责，也是我的乐趣。”
@The_monster@咕哝道：“我从没受过这种训练。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "You will find the Path of Peace easy to follow, in death."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“死后，你会发现和平之路很好走。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "May you follow the Path of Peace in your next life."
@The_monster@ says, "Your soul will be trapped in ice for ten thousand years."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你的灵魂将在冰中被囚禁一万年。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I resented this body once, but could any human make what I've made?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我曾憎恨这具躯体，但哪个人类能做出我这样的作品？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ snarls, "I will not be driven out again."
@The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "I'm done suffering for art; you can suffer instead."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“我已为艺术受够了苦；换成你来受苦吧。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "My silk is a match for both steel and spell."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“我的蛛丝既敌得过钢铁，也敌得过法术。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "I will spin a new home for us all."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“我要为我们大家织一个新家。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ screams @at_foe@, "Burn! Burn! All of it must BURN!"
VISUAL:@The_monster@ is momentarily hidden by a cloud of flames.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@一时被一团火焰遮住了身影。
@The_monster@嘟囔道：“那只爱嫉妒的龟和尚，真该死。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ roars, "Even the heavens can't separate us forever!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@吼道：“就算是老天也不能永远把我们分开！”

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ twists and twirls @possessive@ body through the storm.
VISUAL:@The_monster@ is briefly surrounded by a halo of @_blorkula_colour_@ light.
@The_monster@ screams @at_foe@, "Let me show you how many colours things can be!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@尖叫 @at_foe@：“让我给你看看东西能有多少种颜色！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Beogh has given me so many different colours to drink."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“比欧弗给了我那么多种颜色来喝。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I was weak before I became an orc, but now I'm strong. And I'll get stronger."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“在变成兽人之前我很弱小，但现在我很强壮。而且我会越来越强。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Everything's been so different since that missionary gave me these suspenders."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“自从那位传教士给了我这副背带裤，一切都变得大不一样了。”
@The_monster@咕哝道：“到处都是这么漂亮的颜色……”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "My favourite colour of blood is @_blorkula_colour_@. Wait, no, @_blorkula_colour_@."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我最喜欢的血的颜色是@_blorkula_colour_@。等等，不对，是@_blorkula_colour_@。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ screams, "What are you staring at, @player_name@? I'm stylish!" @player_only@
rows.zh: @The_monster@尖叫道：“你在盯着看什么，@player_name@？我很时髦！”@player_only@

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "The world, the flesh, and the devil."
@The_monster@ says, "There's no good or evil. Just power and will."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“无所谓善恶。只有力量和意志。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "You have all forgotten the taste of death."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你们都已经忘记了死亡的滋味。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ claims, "I care not for such insignificant forces as time or death."
rows.zh: @The_monster@宣称：“我才不在乎时间或死亡这种微不足道的力量。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Magic. You know nothing about it."
@The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Join my legions of the broken and the beaten."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“加入我那支由残破者和失败者组成的大军吧。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "You haven't seen the last of me!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“你还没见到我最后一面呢！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "This isn't the end, it's only just beginning!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“这不是结束，这仅仅是个开始！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ gasps with @possessive@ dying breath, "I... tried to warn you..."
rows.zh: @The_monster@用@possessive@最后一口气喘息道：“我……试着警告过你……”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ gasps with @possessive@ dying breath, "No one... ever listens..."
rows.zh: @The_monster@用@possessive@最后一口气喘息道：“从来没有人……肯听……”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ gasps with @possessive@ dying breath, "Your fate... be upon your own head..."
rows.zh: @The_monster@用@possessive@最后一口气喘息道：“你的命运……终将由你自己承担……”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ begs you to reconsider your quest.
rows.zh: @The_monster@恳求你再考虑一下你的追寻。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ pleads, "Will you not heed even the word of a friend and end this?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@哀求道：“连朋友的话你都不肯听，不肯就此收手吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Even I cannot save you if you persist in this."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你若执意如此，连我也救不了你。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "The life which is unexamined is not worth living."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“未经省察的人生不值得过。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "My goal is simple. It is a complete understanding of the universe, why it is as it is and why it exists at all."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我的目标很简单。那就是彻底理解这个宇宙：它为何如此，它又为何存在。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "One may say the eternal mystery of the world is its comprehensibility."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“可以说，世界永恒的神秘之处就在于它能够被理解。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Which is more difficult, to awaken one who sleeps or to awaken one who, awake, dreams that he is awake?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“把睡着的人唤醒，和唤醒一个醒着却梦见自己醒着的人，哪个更难？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Everyone has the same god; only people differ."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“每个人都有同一个神；不同的只是人。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Against boredom even gods struggle in vain."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“面对无聊，就连众神也徒然挣扎。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "No facts are to me sacred; none are profane; I simply experiment, an endless seeker, with no past at my back."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“对我来说没有神圣的事实，也没有亵渎的事实；我只是不断实验，一个无止境的求索者，身后不留过去。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "The present is the child, and the necessary child, of all the past, and the mother of all the future."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“现在是所有过去的孩子，也是必然的孩子，又是所有未来的母亲。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Reason is nothing but a wonderful and unintelligible instinct in our souls."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“理性不过是我们灵魂中一种奇妙而不可解的直觉。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "It is extremely absurd to expect to be enlightened by reason, and yet to prescribe to it beforehand on which side it must incline."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“一方面期待被理性启蒙，一方面又预先规定理性必须倾向哪一边，这是极其荒谬的。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "The real reality is there, but everything you KNOW about 'it' is in your mind and yours to do with as you like."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“真实的现实就在那里，但你对‘它’所知道的一切都在你自己脑中，随你怎么处置。”
VISUAL:@The_monster@琢磨着一个存在主义困境。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ heaves a sigh in contemplation.
@The_monster@ cries, "You leg down broken song, no?"
@The_monster@ says, "What sane person could live in this world and not be crazy?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“哪个神志正常的人能活在这世上而不发疯？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "What's that horrible smell? It's like... yuck."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“那股恶心味是什么？就像是……呃。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "If there's anything I hate more than water, it's brackish swamp water."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“要说有什么比水更让我讨厌，那就是发臭的沼泽水。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I hate trees. I hate swamp water. I hate this place."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我讨厌树。我讨厌沼泽水。我讨厌这个地方。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "That buzzing noise? I hate that the most."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“那嗡嗡声？那是最让我讨厌的。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "What could mosquitoes possibly want with my blood?"
@The_monster@ says, "I hope these swamp worms drown."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我希望这些沼泽虫全淹死。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Damn it, I left my flaming sword at home."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“该死，我把燃烧的剑忘在家里了。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Don't you hate leeches? I know I do."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你不讨厌水蛭吗？反正我讨厌。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I hate mosquitoes. Almost as much as I hate swamp water."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我讨厌蚊子。几乎跟我讨厌沼泽水一样多。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "At least there's some dry land. I hate getting wet."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“至少还有块干地。我讨厌浑身湿透。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Is there a plague of frogs happening, or something? At least it's not locusts."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“这是闹蛙灾了吗还是怎样？至少不是蝗灾。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "The more heads they grow, the more I hate hydras."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“九头蛇的头长得越多，我就越讨厌它们。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Tides? I despise tides. No, wait, I hate tides!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“潮汐？我鄙视潮汐。不对，等等，我讨厌潮汐！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I like turtle soup. I hate turtles."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我喜欢海龟汤。我讨厌海龟。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I haven't seen any pirates yet. I hate pirates."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我还没见到任何海盗。我讨厌海盗。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "At least this place doesn't smell as bad as the Swamp."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“至少这里没有沼泽那么难闻。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "The sirens are starting to hurt my ears."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“那些塞壬开始震得我耳朵疼了。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Are sirens supposed to sound like that? I can sing better than that!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“塞壬是该那样叫的吗？我唱得都比她们好听！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Where'd the sea come from? I thought this place was underground."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“这片海是打哪来的？我还以为这里在地下。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I like the beach, but I hate the sea."
@The_monster@ says, "These tides are fast. That can't be natural!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“这潮水涨得也太快了。这肯定不正常！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "At least there aren't any ducks around. I hate ducks."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“至少这附近没有鸭子。我讨厌鸭子。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I'm soaked through. I hate being wet!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我浑身湿透了。我讨厌浑身湿透！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Those krakens don't even look real."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“那些克拉肯看起来根本就不像真的。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I'm looking for Ms. Medusa. Have you seen her?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我在找美杜莎女士。你们见过她吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I don't understand half of what these people say. It's all Greek to me."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“这些人说的话我有一半听不懂。对我来说完全是天书。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "And I thought they were famous for their poetry."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我还以为他们以诗歌闻名呢。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I slipped earlier. I hate that."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我刚才滑了一跤。我讨厌这样。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I wish these tides would just make up their mind. In and out, in and out..."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“真希望这潮水能拿个准主意。涨了又退，退了又涨……”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "A turtle bit me. I hate turtles."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“一只海龟咬了我。我讨厌海龟。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "This tentacle just came out of nowhere and touched me. I hate tentacles!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“这条触手不知从哪儿冒出来碰了我一下。我讨厌触手！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I feel like a jelly sandwich, now."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“现在我感觉自己像一块果冻三明治。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I can't smell anything here. I hate that."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“在这里我什么都闻不到。我讨厌这样。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I can't get this icky slime off my feet."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我脚上这黏糊糊的黏液怎么也弄不掉。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I keep getting this feeling like someone's watching me. Creepy."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我老觉得有人在盯着我。真瘆人。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I always freeze up when I think I'm being watched."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“一想到有人在看我，我就会僵住。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Acid blobs make me think of reflux. I hate reflux."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“酸液团总让我想起胃酸倒流。我讨厌胃酸倒流。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "What's up with all this goo? It's like a world of goo. I hate goo."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“这么多黏糊糊的东西是怎么回事？就像一个黏液世界。我讨厌黏液。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Someone said I could use acid to solve all my problems. It just made them worse."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“有人跟我说，用酸能解决我所有的问题。结果只是让问题更糟了。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I hope the rune isn't sticky."
@The_monster@ says, "A rock stubbed itself on my toe. I hate that."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“一块石头自己绊到了我的脚趾上。我讨厌这样。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "What's so magical about quicksilver, anyway?"
@The_monster@ says, "You know that hissing noise? I hate that."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你听到那种嘶嘶声了吗？我讨厌那个。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "You know that slithering noise? I hate that."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你听到那种滑行声了吗？我讨厌那个。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I'd like to make these snakes into gloves, but I hate gloves."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我倒是想把这些蛇做成手套，可我讨厌手套。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "What do naga need barding for?"
@The_monster@ says, "What's a barding, anyway? Does it sing for its supper?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“话说马甲是什么？它会唱歌讨饭吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Robes are for wimps. Real warriors wear heavy armour!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“长袍是给软蛋穿的。真正的战士要穿重甲！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Nagas are pretty ugly. I hate nagas."
@The_monster@ says, "Did all the warriors here go to shield school or something?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“这里的战士是不是都上过盾牌学校？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "So, why is that serpent talking?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“话说回来，那条蛇为什么会说话？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "What sort of name is 'naga' anyway? They're not even good at nagging."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“‘纳迦’这算哪门子名字？他们连唠叨都不在行。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "At least there aren't any garudas. I hate garudas."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“至少这儿没有迦楼罗。我讨厌迦楼罗。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "You'd think there'd be more pits. I haven't seen any."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“按说这儿的坑应该更多才对。我一个都没见着。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I'm sick of this place. Or maybe that's poison..."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我受够这个地方了。或者，也许那是中毒了……”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "So, nagas are stealthy? Don't make me laugh."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“所以，纳迦很擅长潜行？别逗我笑。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I wish they'd hurry up and stop blocking the corridors."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“真希望他们快点让开，别总堵着走廊。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Man, snails must be faster than these guys."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“天哪，蜗牛肯定都比这些家伙快。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "How does a snake shoot lightning, anyway?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“蛇到底是怎么射出闪电的？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "First nagas, now salamanders. What's next, crocodiles with mirrors on their heads?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“先是纳迦，现在是火蜥蜴。接下来是什么，头顶镜子的鳄鱼？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "But I don't want to have to go deeper!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“可我不想再往更深处走啊！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I keep hearing this weird shrieking in my head. I hate that."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我脑子里老是听到奇怪的尖啸。我讨厌这样。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I've never heard of a star cursing anything."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我可从没听说过哪颗星星会诅咒东西。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I've never heard of a star spawning anything."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我可从没听说过哪颗星星会生出东西来。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ throws up @possessive@ hands and says, "Alright, I admit it, I'm lost!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@举起@possessive@双手说：“好吧，我承认，我迷路了！”
@The_monster@说：“我讨厌那种被硬生生撕扯的感觉。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "What's so abyssal about tentacles and stars?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“触手和星星到底哪里深渊了？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Screaming refractions? What's next, yodelling boulders?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“尖叫的折射体？接下来是什么，唱约德尔调的巨石？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I saw a draconian who kept changing colours. Some people are so indecisive."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我刚才看到一条一直在变颜色的龙人。有些人就是这么优柔寡断。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "How come everyone is wearing a cloak down here?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“为什么这底下人人都披着斗篷？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I offered a draconian some spare armour, but he said it didn't fit."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我给了某条龙人一些备用护甲，但他说不合身。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I keep feeling something staring at me. Is it you?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我总觉得有什么东西在盯着我。是你吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "How do you make a golem out of electricity?"
@The_monster@ says, "Orbs of fire, orbs of destruction, the Orb of Zot... what's with all the orbs?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“火焰宝珠、毁灭宝珠、佐特宝珠……怎么这么多宝珠？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Are they setting up a circus down here?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“他们是在这底下搭马戏团吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "This place probably doesn't see many tourists."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“这地方大概没多少游客来。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Oh, so that's what those runes are for!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“哦，原来那些符文是干这个用的！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Why do the walls change colour every floor? Did they keep running out of paint?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“为什么每层墙的颜色都不一样？他们的油漆老是不够用吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "What's stopping the guards from just stealing the Orb themselves?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“是什么拦着守卫们不自己把宝珠偷走？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I hope I don't run into any orbs of ice down here!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“希望我在这底下别撞上什么寒冰宝珠！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Did you bring your rings of ice?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你带上你的寒冰戒指了吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "The Orb of Power is here? Where are the others, then?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“力量宝珠在这里？那其他的呢？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I saw some tasty-looking maize earlier, but it tried to eat me. I hate that."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我刚才看到一些看起来很美味的玉米，可它想吃我。我讨厌这样。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "So much for spreading the word; you get punched in the face instead."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“说到传播福音，结果就是脸上挨一拳。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "This pamphlet doesn't say what the point to Recitation is."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“这份小册子没说明诵经到底有什么意义。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I wanna be an adventurer, not a preacher!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我想当冒险者，不想当传教士！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "What does Zin need our gold for, anyway?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“辛到底要我们的金子干什么？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Something seems a little bit odd about a God who wants to be paid."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“一个想要人付钱的神，总觉得有点不对劲。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I've got two hundred gold pieces. Is that enough to cure these mutations?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我有两百枚金币。这些够治好我身上的变异吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "If I give you twenty gold pieces, can you get rid of this nasty case of scales I've got?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我给你二十枚金币，你能帮我弄掉这身讨厌的鳞片吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Wouldn't you get more for your money with Gozag?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“信哥萨戈的话，你的钱不是更划算吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "How does a bone dragon fly, anyway?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“话说，骨龙到底是怎么飞的？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "How do you flay a ghost, anyway?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“话说，你要怎么剥一个幽灵的皮？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Pah! You're not even a real necromancer."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“呸！你根本不算个真正的死灵法师。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Did you drop out of Necromancy School?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你是从死灵学院退学的吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Ah. You're responsible for all those zombies."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“啊。那些僵尸都是你搞出来的。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Zombies? Spectres? Don't you get bored without any real company?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“僵尸？幽灵？没有真正的同伴，你不觉得无聊吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Angels painted black are so last century."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“天使涂成黑色早就过时了。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "If you wanted the light to be dimmer, you could have said so."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你要是想让光暗一点，早说啊。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "What kind of torch can only be lit once per level?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“什么样的火把一层只能用一次？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "How does that torch stay lit when you throw its fire all over?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你把火把的火到处乱扔，它怎么还亮着？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "At least you've got demons for company."
@The_monster@ says, "Are you sure that summoning demons is a good idea?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你确定召唤恶魔是个好主意？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Hey, watch where you throw those bolts!"
@The_monster@ says, "What will you do after everything's destroyed?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“等一切都毁灭了，你打算干什么？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I just stubbed my toe. Does that mean I'm cleansed?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我刚撞到脚趾了。这是不是说明我被净化了？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "If I carve 'Go Away' into myself, will Makhleb do that?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“如果我在自己身上刻上‘滚开’，马科列布也会这么干吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "What's the Crucible of Flesh? Some kind of fancy barbecue place?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“血肉熔炉是什么？某家高级烤肉店吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Don't you wish for a portable bookcase?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你不想要一个便携书架吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Imagine how many trees were cut down to fuel your hobby."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“想想为了你的爱好，有多少树被砍倒了。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Man, that must be some big library."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“天哪，那图书馆肯定大得吓人。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Found the spell you wanted yet?"
@The_monster@ says, "If you wanted to read so much, why didn't you become a librarian?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“既然你这么爱读书，怎么不去当图书管理员？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Did you remember that thing that you forgot? I hate that."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你想起你忘掉的那件事了吗？我讨厌这样。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "It's like an all you can read... something."
@The_monster@ says, "Surely there's a limit to the number of books you can carry. Right?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你能带的书肯定是有上限的吧。对吧？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "It's good how you can learn magic as if by magic."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你能像变魔法一样学会魔法，这挺好的。”
@The_monster@说：“你就说，你不讨厌法术失误吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Whatever happened to, 'First, do no harm'?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“‘首先，不可伤害’这话都上哪儿去了？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Doesn't healing your enemies sound rather pointless?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“治疗你的敌人，听着就毫无意义，不是吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "If I give you my weapon, will you leave me alone?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我把武器给你，你就不烦我了吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Come on. Make me an offer of peace that I can't refuse!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“来吧。给我一个我无法拒绝的和平提议！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "For every monster you don't kill, I'll kill three."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你每少杀一个怪物，我就多杀三个。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Why would you want to visit the Abyss? For a holiday?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你为什么要去深渊？度假吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Nothing ever attacks me when I'm in the Abyss."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我在深渊里的时候，什么都不会来攻击我。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Are you going to banish me, too?"
@The_monster@ says, "The world's bad enough without you corrupting it."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“这世界已经够糟了，你别再腐化它了。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "You must really love eldritch horrors. I hate them."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你一定很喜欢那些诡异的恐怖之物。我讨厌它们。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "How can a god be banished to the Abyss?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“一个神怎么会被放逐到深渊？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Beogh must be pretty vain, having all those worshippers get remade in Beogh's image."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“比欧弗一定很虚荣，让所有信徒都照着祂的样子重塑自己。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "One of the priests looked like she was going to ask me to join... I guess she changed her mind."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“有个女祭司看起来像要拉我入教……我猜她改主意了。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "You think walking on water is cool? I can swim."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你觉得在水上行走很酷？我会游泳。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Isn't it annoying when people just start challenging you, and you can't get away from them?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“别人突然来挑战你，你还甩不掉他们，这不是很烦吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I'd get sick of only having three followers at most."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“最多只能有三个追随者，我可受不了。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "How do you find enough ash and charcoal to anoint them all?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你上哪儿找那么多草木灰和木炭来给他们涂油？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "You'll need more than orcs to take me on."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“想拿下我，光靠兽人可不够。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Do you like preaching on mountaintops?"
@The_monster@ says, "What is divine providence, anyway? I hate that."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“‘神意’到底是个什么？我讨厌这样。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "You'd better watch out. The one on the left looks like he gets lost easily."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你最好小心点。左边那个看起来很容易迷路。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "You think you're the Messiah? I met another orc who thought that, too."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你以为你是弥赛亚？我还见过另一个兽人这么想呢。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ bows and submits to you. "Nah, just kidding."
rows.zh: @The_monster@鞠了一躬，向你臣服。“哈，开玩笑的。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Don't fight so hard! You'll just burn out."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“别那么拼命！你会把自己烧尽的。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Huh, so Ignis will die when you do... how's that make you feel?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“哦，所以伊格尼斯会在你死的时候一起熄灭……这让你什么感觉？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "You'd think a god of fire would be a bit brighter."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你会以为火神多少该亮一点。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Feel like your fire's burning out? I hate that."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“觉得你的火快烧完了？我讨厌这样。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "You know a god's a real winner when you're their only follower, right?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你是祂唯一的信徒，可见这位神有多成功，对吧？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Oh, I wondered where that burning smell was coming from."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“哦，我还在想那股烧焦味是从哪来的。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Why not join one of those new, up-and-coming flame gods instead?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“为什么不改信那些新冒头、有前途的火焰神呢？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Doesn't it hurt to go crashing headfirst through the ceiling?"
@The_monster@ says, "Wow, you can rise to a higher floor... isn't that called 'climbing stairs'?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“哇，你能升到上层去……那不就是叫‘爬楼梯’吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Wow, fire everywhere! I hate that."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“哇，到处都是火！我讨厌这样。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "You're not very quick on the uptake, are you?"
@The_monster@ says, "You know, if you want, I know a very good posture trainer."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“知道吗，你要是想，我认识一位特别好的体态教练。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Am I talking too fast for you?"
@The_monster@ says, "Look at me! I'm running, I'm running!"
@The_monster@ says, "How about we settle this with a race?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“要不我们用一场赛跑来分个高下？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "If it's mutations you're wanting, wouldn't Jiyva be a better deal?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你要是想要变异，信吉瓦不是更划算吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I hope you love dancing weapons. I hate them."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“希望你喜欢跳舞的武器。我讨厌它们。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Been surrounded by packs of demons recently? I hate that."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“最近被成群的恶魔围过吗？我讨厌这样。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Xom just doesn't make any sense. I hate that."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“佐姆根本毫无道理可言。我讨厌这样。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "What kind of name is 'Xom', anyway?"
@The_monster@ says, "What is a 'random number god' anyway?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“‘随机数之神’到底是什么玩意？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I had a teddy bear once. I hated it."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我曾经有一只泰迪熊。我讨厌它。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "You seem like a real know-it-all. I hate that."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你看起来真是无所不知。我讨厌这样。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "What's the point of being all-knowing if you can't do anything?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“如果什么都做不了，那无所不知还有什么意义？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ makes a face at you and exclaims, "Curses!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@朝你做了个鬼脸，叫道：“天杀的！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I got nailed to the sky once. No big deal, really."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我有一次被钉在天上。没什么大不了的，真的。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "What does a god have to do to get cursed, anyway?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“一个神得干出什么事才会被诅咒？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Sounds like you're dealing with a pretty shady god there."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“听起来你信的那位神相当阴暗啊。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I'll bet you have a pretty dark future."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我打赌你的前途一片漆黑。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ squints around. "I can't see a thing. I hate that."
rows.zh: @The_monster@眯着眼四处看。“我什么都看不见。我讨厌这样。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Are you still afraid of the dark?"
@The_monster@ says, "Careful; you might trip over your own shadow."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“小心点；你可能会被自己的影子绊倒。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Once, I gave up eating meat for a week. I hated that."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“有一次我戒肉戒了一星期。我讨厌那样。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Once, I gave up drinking for a week. I hated that."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“有一次我戒酒戒了一星期。我讨厌那样。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I hate hidden layers of reality."

rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我讨厌存在主义式的怀疑。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "The great annihilating truth is that I hate you."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“那伟大的湮灭真理就是：我讨厌你。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "What are you with all those gadgets, some kind of pawn shop?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“看你身上这些装置，你是开当铺的吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "What would you do with the Orb, anyway? Experiment on it?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你打算拿宝珠干什么？拿它做实验？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Bet you can't [analyse|invent] your way out of this one."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“这次你[分析|发明]不出一条出路了吧。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Can I borrow that [wand|lamp|fan] for a second? You must have some to spare."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“那个[魔杖|灯|扇子]能借我用一下吗？你肯定有多余的。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Dance? No thanks, I don't dance."
@The_monster@ says, "Poetry of the foot? All you're doing is stomping around."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“脚的诗歌？你不就是在原地跺来跺去吗。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "You look ridiculous with all that flailing around."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你那通乱甩的样子真滑稽。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "That's not dancing; that's just a fancy way of killing things."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“那根本不是跳舞；那只是杀东西的花哨方式。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "What kind of dance blows up spectators?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“什么样的舞能把观众都炸飞？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Don't you get lonely without a god?"
@The_monster@ says, "I hate the gods, and the gods hate me."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我讨厌众神，众神也讨厌我。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "You must run out of gods to curse by."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你诅咒人的时候，能拿来发誓的神一定不够用吧。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Did you miss the Ecumenical Temple?"
@The_monster@ says, "Everybody knows that one already. Try something more original."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“这个大家都知道。换个新鲜点的。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I won. I... don't hate that."
@The_monster@ says, "Well, maybe you weren't so bad after all."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“好吧，也许你其实没那么差。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I will find her! I will get her back!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我会找到她！我会把她带回来！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I will find a way to undo this!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我会找到办法逆转这一切！”

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ smirks and points a slender finger @at_foe@.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@得意一笑，用纤细的手指指向 @at_foe@。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Magic and the sword, together, will defeat you." @player_only@
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“魔法与剑合璧，必将击败你。”@player_only@

rows.raw: @The_monster_possessive@ eyes darken. "You have made a grave mistake."
rows.zh: @The_monster_possessive@双眼暗了下来。“你犯下了大错。”

rows.raw: You hear a distant wail of despair.
rows.zh: 你听到远方传来绝望的哀号。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ shakes in a combination of rage and grief.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@在狂怒与悲痛中颤抖着。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Where magic fails, the sword succeeds!"
@The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "When magic and the sword combine, nothing stands against them."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“当魔法与剑合为一体，任何东西都抵挡不住。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ @_shouts_@ @to_foe@, "You can run, but you cannot escape us forever!" @player_only@
rows.zh: @The_monster@ @_shouts_@ @to_foe@：“你可以逃，但你不可能永远躲开我们！”@player_only@

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "I don't care about looks, I care about technique!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“我不在意外表，我在意的是技艺！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Did you see that move? Perfect!"
@The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Beauty is only skin deep, and my weapons penetrate much further than that."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“美貌只是皮相，而我的武器能刺得比那深得多。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Practise, practise, practise! One day you'll be as good as me." @player_only@
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“练，练，再练！总有一天你会和我一样强。”@player_only@

rows.raw: You hear a distant scream of rage.
rows.zh: 你听到远方传来愤怒的尖叫。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "You wouldn't believe how much I paid for this flail."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你不会相信我花多少钱买了这把连枷。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ asks @foe,@ "Have you met my wondrous brother?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@问@foe,@：“你见过我那位了不起的哥哥吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "I might not be good at magic, but I can still kill you!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“我可能不擅长魔法，但我照样能杀了你！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "People think my brother is the best. I think he's crazy."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“大家都觉得我哥哥最厉害。我觉得他疯了。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I'm quite good with sums, too."
@The_monster@ says, "People accused me of being a cutpurse!"

rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@愤怒地扭动着她的触手。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "I'm so much better than you."
@The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "I love to horrify, but killing's even better."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“我爱让人恐惧，但杀人更妙。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Fast and perfect. Such is my way of killing."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“又快又完美。这就是我杀人的方式。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ screams @at_foe@, "Your blood will spurt and your skin will burst!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@尖叫 @at_foe@：“你的血会喷涌，你的皮会爆裂！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ screams, "Wait! Erolcha supposed to do that!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@尖叫道：“等等！这事应该是厄洛卡干的才对！”

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ runs a finger over @possessive@ scar.

rows.zh: @The_monster@用一种无法解读的语言说话。
@The_monster@咕哝出一个几乎无法说出口的词。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Show me proof of your conquests, and I will call you a great adventurer." @player_only@
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“拿出你征服的战利品给我看，我就称你为伟大的冒险者。”@player_only@

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I command an army of devils. What do you command?" @player_only@
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我指挥着一支恶魔大军。你指挥什么？”@player_only@

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I value strength and power. I see none of this in you." @player_only@
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我看重力量和权势。我在你身上一样都看不到。”@player_only@

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I speak the language of demons!"

rows.zh: @The_monster@嚎叫出一句难以形容的诅咒。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I have seen worlds and universes beyond all imagining."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我见过超乎一切想象的世界与宇宙。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Pah! Those who rely on gods for strength get nowhere in life."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“呸！那些靠神明来获取力量的人，这辈子一事无成。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ rants about the fall of honour.
@The_monster@ says, "All of you adventurers look the same to me! Bumbling weaklings, the lot!" @player_only@
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你们这些冒险者在我看来都一个样！一群笨手笨脚的废物！”@player_only@

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "For you, today is the most challenging fight of your life. For me... well, I will have lunch shortly." @player_only@
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“对你来说，今天是你此生最具挑战的一战。对我来说……嗯，我待会儿就要吃午饭了。”@player_only@

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Perhaps I should have been a lumberjack. The trees might put up more of a fight."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“也许我该去做个伐木工。树说不定还能反抗得更像样些。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Killing you would be a chore, not a joy." @player_only@
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“杀你只会是件苦差，而非乐事。”@player_only@

rows.raw: @The_monster@ eyes @foe@ carefully. "They told me only worthy opponents would get this far."
rows.zh: @The_monster@仔细打量着@foe@。“他们跟我说，只有配得上的对手才能走到这里。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ sighs, "Someday I'll have a real challenge."
rows.zh: @The_monster@叹息道：“总有一天我会遇上一个真正的挑战。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "You don't even know how to die right."
@The_monster@ sighs, "Killing weak @player_genus_plural@ does nothing to prove my superiority."
rows.zh: @The_monster@叹息道：“屠杀弱小的@player_genus_plural@，证明不了我的优越。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ sighs, "Your wits are somehow even duller than your claws."
rows.zh: @The_monster@叹息道：“你的脑子，竟比你的爪子还钝。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Be happy - you can't get any slower than dead."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“开心点吧——你没法比死人更慢了。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Time for you to vanish into the darkness."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“该让你消失在黑暗之中了。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Foolish to worship a god whose flame is even dimmer than you."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“信奉一个火焰比你还要黯淡的神，真是愚蠢。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Our battle was as dull and shapeless as your god."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我们的战斗和你的神一样乏味、一样不成形状。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ sighs, "Relying on the knowledge of others got you nowhere, mortal."
rows.zh: @The_monster@叹息道：“依赖他人的学问，让你一事无成，凡人。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "The adventurer who shines twice as bright burns out twice as fast."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“光芒亮两倍的冒险者，烧尽也快两倍。”

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ brushes some snowflakes from @possessive@ robe.
@The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "I shall freeze you to your soul!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“我要把你连灵魂一起冻住！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "You will make a fine ice sculpture."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“你会成为一件精美的冰雕。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Does this not give you the chills?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“这难道不让你不寒而栗吗？”
@The_monster@咕噜道：“我要吃了你，一定会的！”

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ sniffs the air and quickly glances around.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@嗅了嗅空气，飞快地扫视四周。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ glances around and shouts, "@_Grum_dog_name_@! Here boy!"
VISUAL:@The_monster@ is momentarily distracted by a flea in @possessive@ coat.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@一时被@possessive@外套里的一只跳蚤分了神。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ @_Grum_verb_@ @at_foe@, "My dogs and I will have a feast tonight..."
rows.zh: @The_monster@ @_Grum_verb_@ @at_foe@：“今晚我和我的狗要大快朵颐……”
@The_monster@ @_Grum_verb_@ @at_foe@：“我要像捏死只小狗一样捏扁你。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ looks @at_foe@ in disgust and @_Grum_verb_@, "You ain't no friend of mine."
rows.zh: @The_monster@厌恶地看着 @at_foe@，@_Grum_verb_@：“你可不是我的朋友。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ cheerfully says, "No dog meat for Grum tonight!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@兴高采烈地说：“今晚格鲁姆没有狗肉吃了！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ asks, "What kind of bones do @player_genus_plural@ have? My dogs are dying to find out." @player_only@
rows.zh: @The_monster@问：“@player_genus_plural@的骨头是什么样的？我的狗都等不及想知道了。”@player_only@

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "What's my secret? I feed my dogs @player_genus_plural@. It makes their fur nice and shiny." @player_only@
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“我的秘诀是什么？我喂我的狗吃@player_genus_plural@。这让它们的毛皮又亮又滑。”@player_only@

rows.raw: @The_monster@ looks @at_foe@ and @_Grum_verb_@, "Time to put down the runt of the litter."
rows.zh: @The_monster@看着 @at_foe@，@_Grum_verb_@：“是时候处理掉这窝里最弱的那只了。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ @_Grum_verb_@ @at_foe@, "Me and @_Grum_dog_name_@ will play fetch with your bones!"
@The_monster@ @_Grum_verb_@, "Who's a good boy? That's right, @_Grum_dog_name_@... you are!"
@The_monster@ @_Grum_verb_@ @at_foe@, "You will fight me? This will be... rough!"
@The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "I'm selling these fine leather pelts."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“我在卖这些上好的皮革毛皮。”

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ pats at a spot of missing fur and sighs.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@拍了拍身上一处秃掉的地方，叹了口气。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ @_Grum_verb_@ @at_foe@, "My dogs and I will have a feast tonight..."
rows.zh: @The_monster@ @_Grum_verb_@ @at_foe@：“今晚我和我的狗要大快朵颐……”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ @_Grum_verb_@ @at_foe@, "I don't need to eat anymore, but I'll make an exception for you."
rows.zh: @The_monster@ @_Grum_verb_@ @at_foe@：“我不用再吃东西了，但我会为你破个例。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ asks, "What kind of bones do @player_genus_plural@ have? My dogs are dying to find out." @player_only@
rows.zh: @The_monster@问：“@player_genus_plural@的骨头是什么样的？我的狗都等不及想知道了。”@player_only@

rows.raw: @The_monster@ looks @at_foe@ and @_Grum_verb_@, "Time to put down the runt of the litter."
rows.zh: @The_monster@看着 @at_foe@，@_Grum_verb_@：“是时候处理掉这窝里最弱的那只了。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ @_Grum_verb_@ @at_foe@, "Me and @_Grum_dog_name_@ will play fetch with your bones!"
@The_monster@ lets out a long, sad whine.
rows.zh: @The_monster@发出一声长长的、凄凉的哀鸣。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Selling your soul isn't that bad. What the hell, right?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“出卖灵魂也没那么糟。管他呢，对吧？”

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ looks eager to get this over with.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@看起来巴不得赶紧了结此事。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ grumbles @at_foe@, "Just give up already, I want to go home!"
@The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "I was hoping my final job would be more of a challenge, but money is money."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“我本希望我最后一单能更有挑战性，但钱就是钱。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ shouts @at_foe@, "Can you die now? I had plans for the rest of the day!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@喊道 @at_foe@：“你能现在就去死吗？我今天剩下的时间都安排好了！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Do you have any idea what people are willing to pay to have you killed, @player_name@?" @player_only@
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你知道人们愿意出多少钱买你的命吗，@player_name@？”@player_only@

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Let's make it quick, okay? I've got mouths to feed."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“咱们速战速决，行吗？我还有几张嘴要喂。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Listen, it's nothing personal. It's just a job."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“听着，这不是私人恩怨。这只是份工作。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "This is so exciting! What a great way to end my career!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“这太让人兴奋了！多么完美的收山之作！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Ah, this is what I got into this business for!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“啊，我入这行就是为了这个！”

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ pauses a moment, imagining something with a smile on @possessive@ face.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@停顿片刻，脸上带着微笑，想象着@possessive@心中所想。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ considers, "I think I'll use your bounty to get a @_Harold_retirement_plan_@..." @player_only@
rows.zh: @The_monster@盘算道：“我想我可以用你的赏金换一处@_Harold_retirement_plan_@……”@player_only@

rows.raw: @The_monster@ asks, "Do you mind if I name my boat the '@player_name@'? Your head will be paying for it, after all." @player_only@
rows.zh: @The_monster@问：“你介意我把我的船命名为‘@player_name@’号吗？毕竟你的脑袋会替我付这笔钱。”@player_only@

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says happily, "The price on your head will fill my nest egg nicely!" @player_only@
rows.zh: @The_monster@开心地说：“你脑袋上的赏金正好能填满我的养老本！”@player_only@

rows.raw: @The_monster@ thinks, and says @to_foe@, "Perhaps I'll take up @_Harold_ret_hobby_@ after I'm done here..."
rows.zh: @The_monster@想了想，说 @to_foe@：“等我干完这票，也许我就去@_Harold_ret_hobby_@了……”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Try to look on the bright side. Your death will help put my children through school." @player_only@
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“往好处想吧。你的死能帮我的孩子们交学费。”@player_only@

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Bounty hunting has been great, but I can't wait to retire."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“当赏金猎人一直很不错，但我等不及要退休了。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "My wife will appreciate not having to wash blood out of my clothes anymore."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“我妻子会很高兴再也不用从我的衣服上洗血迹了。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Can't wait to tell my little ones about this."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我迫不及待要把这事讲给我的孩子们听。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ sighs, "Finally, I can get that @_Harold_retirement_plan_@ and settle down."
rows.zh: @The_monster@叹息道：“终于，我能拿到@_Harold_retirement_plan_@，安顿下来了。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ sighs, "Nothing for old @the_monster@ but @_Harold_ret_hobby_@ after this."
rows.zh: @The_monster@叹息道：“从今往后，老@the_monster@除了@_Harold_ret_hobby_@，再没别的可干了。”

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ looks at @possessive@ axe, then at @foe@, then at @possessive@ axe, then at @foe@...
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@看看@possessive@斧头，再看看@foe@，又看看@possessive@斧头，再看看@foe@……

rows.raw: @The_monster@ exclaims, "Oh yes! We are going to have fun!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@大声说道：“哦，太好了！我们会玩得很开心的！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Pain is my business; you will see!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“痛苦就是我的生意；你会见识到的！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ screams @at_foe@, "Don't stand in way of progress!"
@The_monster@ screams @at_foe@, "Me yet to meet anyone who can outsmart wand!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@尖叫 @at_foe@：“俺还没见过谁能斗得过俺的法杖！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ cowers and screams, "Me head! Aaaah! Get out now!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@缩成一团，尖叫道：“俺的脑袋！啊啊啊！给俺滚出去！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ screams @at_foe@, "Me give you whole level! Then you leave me be!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@尖叫 @at_foe@：“俺把整层都让给你！你别再来烦俺！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ screams @at_foe@, "Wand still stronger! You very nasty!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@尖叫 @at_foe@：“魔杖还是更厉害！你太坏了！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ screams @at_foe@, "Me be nice to you! Me promise!"
@The_monster@ screams, "Me go back to drawing board!"

rows.zh: @The_monster@尖叫 @at_foe@：“别对俺使那种邪门魔法！”

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ clutches @possessive@ head and gibbers rapidly, swaying.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@抱着@possessive@脑袋，一边摇晃，一边飞快地胡言乱语。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ moans, "Good help so hard to find!"
@The_monster@ asks @foe,@ "Won't you come swim with me?"
@The_monster@ whispers @to_foe@, "Come on in, the water's fine."

rows.zh: @The_monster@唱起一支[奇异的|萦绕不去的][水手号子|旋律]。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ runs @possessive@ fingers through @possessive@ long green hair.
@The_monster@ very coldly says @to_foe@, "I hate your company."
rows.zh: @The_monster@非常冷淡地说 @to_foe@：“我讨厌有你作伴。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ shouts @at_foe@, "I don't like beings like you!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@喊道 @at_foe@：“我不喜欢像你这样的存在！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ shouts @at_foe@, "Stop bothering me, or I'll kill you!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@喊道 @at_foe@：“别再烦我，不然我就杀了你！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Oh, this is an awfully strange dream."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“哦，这真是个非常奇怪的梦。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ asks, "Am I dreaming? Is this real?"
@The_monster@ shouts, "Stop it! Stop making me do this!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@喊道：“停下！别再让我做这种事！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "I don't want to hurt you. Just - go! Run!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“我不想伤害你。只要——走！快跑！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ asks, "Where am I? Why are you fighting me?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@问：“我在哪儿？你为什么要和我打？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ whispers, "I obey. I obey. I obey."
rows.zh: @The_monster@低声说：“我服从。我服从。我服从。”

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster_possessive@ eyes close briefly, then snap open.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster_possessive@双眼短暂闭上，随即猛然睁开。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster_possessive@ eyes momentarily flash bright red.
VISUAL:@The_monster@ looks at @possessive@ weapon with confusion.
@The_monster@ wails, "Just end it! Let me go!"
@The_monster@ sobs, "I don't want it. Make it stop! Make it stop!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@抽泣道：“我不要它。让它停下！让它停下！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Oh, this must be a dream. This is totally unrealistic."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“哦，这一定是个梦。这完全不真实。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Oh, what beautiful sparkles and rainbows everywhere!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“哦，到处都是多么美丽的闪光和彩虹啊！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ asks @foe@, "Have you seen the dreamshard? I... I need it..."
rows.zh: @The_monster@问@foe@：“你见过梦之碎片吗？我……我需要它……”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ whispers, "Once you die, everything will be fine. It promises."
rows.zh: @The_monster@低声说：“等你一死，一切都会好起来的。它保证过。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Time for a nap after this, I think."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“这事之后该打个盹了，我想。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ asks @foe@, "Would you mind waking me up? Thanks muchly."
rows.zh: @The_monster@问@foe@：“能麻烦你叫醒我吗？多谢了。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ wails, "It wants to be free! It wants to enslave everyone!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@哀号道：“它想获得自由！它想把所有人都变成奴隶！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ asks @foe@, "Where did this trident come from? Is it yours?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@问@foe@：“这把三叉戟是从哪儿来的？是你的吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ giggles, "Dreams, dreams, come out to play!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@咯咯笑道：“梦啊，梦啊，出来玩吧！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "'tis place shall be yer tomb!"
@The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Tha earth be me home, an' ye be trespassing!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“大地就是俺的家，是你在擅闯！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I've ne'er se'n tha particular type o' rock formation 'fore."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“俺以前从没见过这种岩层。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "A few more walls knocked out 'ere an' thar an' 'tis whole place will come crashin' down."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“再往外敲掉几堵墙，这地方整个都得塌下来。”
@The_monster@用一种不可知的语言嘶嘶作声。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Get out, get out, get out!"
@The_monster@ says, "My wife rejected me, but I had my revenge."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我妻子拒绝了我，但我报了仇。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ screams, "No, no!" before exploding into a cloud of blood!
rows.zh: @The_monster@尖叫着“不，不！”，随即炸成了一团血雾！

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ momentarily stares at you in horror, before exploding into a cloud of blood!
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@惊恐地盯着你看了片刻，随即炸成了一团血雾！

rows.raw: VISUAL:One of @the_monster_possessive@ icy fingers falls off.
@The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "I'll make a rug of your skin."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“我要用你的皮做一张地毯。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ howls, "Hell holds no secrets from me!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@嚎叫道：“地狱对我毫无秘密可言！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ shouts @at_foe@, "You can't hurt me! Ice reforms..."
rows.zh: @The_monster@喊道 @at_foe@：“你伤不了我！冰会重新凝结……”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ screams, "I will never die! I am immortal!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@尖叫道：“我永远不会死！我是不朽的！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ screams @at_foe@, "I'll use your head as a decoration in Hell!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@尖叫 @at_foe@：“我要用你的头去装饰地狱！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ booms, "Everyone will worship Khufu but you!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@吼道：“所有人都会崇拜胡夫，除了你！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ declares, "When I'm finished with you, I will take on the gods!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@宣称：“等我把你收拾完，我就要去挑战众神！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ queries, "My people built me a pyramid - what did your people build for you?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@问道：“我的人民为我建了一座金字塔——你的人民为你建了什么？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "This hit and run is way beneath me."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“这种打了就跑的把戏，实在有失我的身份。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I am transcendence, you are transpiration."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我是超凡脱俗，你是汗流浃背。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Your corpse would blemish any mausoleum."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“你的尸体只会玷污任何一座陵墓。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "You'll be the most ugly mummy ever seen."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“你会成为有史以来最丑陋的木乃伊。”
VISUAL:@The_monster@撒出一把[奇怪的|诡异的|神秘的]粉末，撒向 @at_foe@。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Odis was a nice man; you're awful."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“奥德修斯是个好人，你可真差劲。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ holds @possessive@ sides and says @to_foe@, "You'll eat dirt beneath my feet."
rows.zh: @The_monster@捂着@possessive@肚子，说 @to_foe@：“你会趴在我脚边吃土。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ whispers @to_foe@, "Not even holy moly will save you."
rows.zh: @The_monster@低声说 @to_foe@：“就算是神圣的魔草也救不了你。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Can we stop fighting? I have some good wine for you..." @player_only@
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我们别打了好吗？我这儿有好酒给你……” @player_only@

rows.raw: @The_monster@ shouts @at_foe@, "You pig! I'll make you look the way you deserve."
rows.zh: @The_monster@吼道 @at_foe@：“你这头猪！我要让你变成你应得的模样。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ whispers @to_foe@, "You'd look cute with a curly little tail."
rows.zh: @The_monster@低声说 @to_foe@：“你要是有条卷卷的小尾巴，一定很可爱。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Work for me? I pay good."
@The_monster@ shouts, "Zap! Ha ha ha, made you jump."
@The_monster@ roars, "I Iron Bound! You Brass... Trash!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@吼道：“俺是铁铸的！你是黄铜——是破烂！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ grins wickedly and says, "Money make world go round."
rows.zh: @The_monster@邪恶地咧嘴一笑，说：“钱让世界转起来。”
@The_monster@眨了眨眼，说 @at_foe@：“什么东西都有价。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "All wealth is product of labour."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“所有财富都是劳动的产物。”
@The_monster@说：“能干的食人魔就是快乐的食人魔。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Lodul motto: Secure Vault? My fault!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“洛杜尔的座右铭：宝库守不住？是俺的错！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ frowns @at_foe@ and says, "You violating area security."
rows.zh: @The_monster@皱起眉头，说 @at_foe@：“你在破坏区域安全。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Even the Abyss couldn't kill me! What makes you think you can?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“连深渊都杀不死我！你凭什么以为你能？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Powers from beyond reality are at my beck and call!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“超越现实的力量任我差遣！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Need a shortcut to the ORB? Here, let me help!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“想要一条通往宝珠的捷径？来，我帮你！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ asks, "Why won't you be my friend?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@问：“你为什么不肯做我的朋友？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I've come back once... I'll do it again!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我已经回来过一次了……我还会再回来的！”

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ smiles, but it's obviously fake.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@微笑着，但一看就是装的。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Leave now, and tell all of Maggie's mercy!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“现在就走，去传扬玛吉的仁慈！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Fear not. I will immortalise you in the tale of my first kill."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“别怕。我会让你在我的第一次杀戮故事里永垂不朽。”

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ gives @reflexive@ a magical halo, but it quickly sputters out.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@给@reflexive@套上一圈魔法光环，但光环很快便噼啪熄灭。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ mumbles the words to a spell, but in the wrong order.
rows.zh: @The_monster@喃喃念着一段咒语，但词序错了。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "If you die in the Dungeon, but nobody's around to see it, does it really matter?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“如果你死在地牢里，但周围没人看见，那真的算数吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "How do the people who live here stand the isolation?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“住在这里的人是怎么忍受这种与世隔绝的？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ mutters to @reflexive@, "Master Lance won't take me back. This is the way forward."
rows.zh: @The_monster@对@reflexive@喃喃道：“兰斯师父不会再收留我了。前进才是出路。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I mislead the hearts of men!"
@The_monster@ says, "What good are steel and magic against my illusions?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“钢铁与魔法，对我的幻象又有何用？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Entranced by some poetic flight, are you?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你被某段诗意的飞升迷住了，是吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Bound art thou by all the snares!"

rows.zh: @The_monster@尖叫道：“愿你的诅咒十倍降临！”

rows.raw: @The_monster_possessive@ features momentarily become yours. "Wouldst slay thyself?"
rows.zh: @The_monster_possessive@面容一瞬间变成了你的模样。“你要弑己吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I stand as high above you as a star above the ocean's bottom."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我高踞于你之上，如同星辰之于海渊。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ smirks. "I am one who seeks the Path and the Right."
rows.zh: @The_monster@得意一笑。“我就是那求索大道与正法之人。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Thou art lean, ill-favoured, death is in thy neighbourhood!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你瘦弱不堪、形容可憎，死神就在你左右！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Difficult is the way of exertion, difficult to pass, difficult to enter upon."
@The_monster@ calls, "Stop! In seven days from now the wheel of empire will appear!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@呼喊道：“停下！七天之后，转轮圣王将会出现！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ boasts, "I am lord over the four continents and the two thousand adjacent isles."
rows.zh: @The_monster@夸口道：“我是四大洲与两千座近海岛屿之主。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ smirks. "I shall give thine eyesight a greater riddle by far."
rows.zh: @The_monster@得意地一笑。“我要给你的眼力出一道难得多的大谜题。”

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster_possessive@ eyes start to glow with a @_spell_colour_@ light.

rows.zh:
VISUAL:@The_monster@做着手势。
VISUAL:你感到[被诅咒|在劫难逃]。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ throws some purple powder towards you.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@朝你撒来一些紫色粉末。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ tries to stalk through the shadows.
VISUAL:@The_monster@ lashes his vines and gnashes his teeth.
@The_monster@ says, "Nice gear. Can I borrow some?"
@The_monster@ says, "Betcha didn't see that coming, eh?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我打赌你没料到这一手吧，嗯？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says to @foe@, "Money or life? Never mind, I think I'll take both."
rows.zh: @The_monster@对@foe@说：“要钱还是要命？算了，我想我两样都要。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Killing adventurers, taking their stuff. It's what he did, it's what I do."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“杀冒险者，抢他们的东西。他当年这么干，我也这么干。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ mutters, "Now where did you hide it?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@嘟囔道：“你到底把它藏到哪儿去了？”
@The_monster@呻吟道：“你是什么人啊，苦行僧吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ clumsily fails to latch onto your valuables.
rows.zh: @The_monster@笨手笨脚地没能抓住你的财物。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ fumbles for your pockets and misses.
rows.zh: @The_monster@摸索着你的口袋，却摸了个空。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ lunges for your pockets and trips.
rows.zh: @The_monster@朝你的口袋扑去，却绊了一跤。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ sings off-key, "You got some money for me?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@跑调地唱道：“你有钱给我花吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster_possessive@ ankle releases a plume of dust as @subjective@ confides, "I'm not really a mummy, you know."
rows.zh: @The_monster_possessive@脚踝扬起一缕尘土，@subjective@坦言道：“你知道，我其实不是木乃伊。”

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ forgets how to speak, silenced by the ages.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@忘记了如何言语，被岁月夺去了声音。
@The_monster@喊道 @at_foe@：“你打扰了我的安眠！死吧！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ @_Menkaure_verb_@ @to_foe@, "From dust you came, to dust you will return."
@The_monster@ shouts @at_foe@, "The sands of time shall wipe you from history!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@喊道 @at_foe@：“时间之沙将把你从历史中抹去！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ shouts @at_foe@, "The curse of the Pharaohs be upon you!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@喊道 @at_foe@：“愿法老的诅咒降临于你！”

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ draws the symbol "Udjat" in the dust.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@在尘土中画出“乌加特”符号。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ is caught in a moment of prayer.
VISUAL:@The_monster@ says something you can't hear. It was probably not a compliment. @player_only@
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@说了些什么，可你听不见。那多半不是什么恭维话。 @player_only@

rows.raw: You feel @the_monster_possessive@ spirit has finally been put to rest.
rows.zh: 你感到@the_monster_possessive@灵魂终于得以安息。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ laughs in a distinctly smug fashion.

rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@威吓地鼓起一块二头肌。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Can you balance on a beach ball? I can!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你能在沙滩球上保持平衡吗？我能！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Circuses are really nothing more than prisons."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“马戏团其实只不过是监狱罢了。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I'll never walk a tight-rope again!"
@The_monster@ says, "Don't worry about being fed to the lions. Worry about being fed to me."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“别担心被喂给狮子。该担心的是被喂给我。”

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ flaps @possessive@ ears in an attempt at flight.
@The_monster@ says, "Do you know Lommy? A good friend!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你认识洛米吗？我的好朋友！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "No, I don't have a problem with mice."
@The_monster@ says, "You have no idea what it means to truly have nothing. We will teach you."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你根本不知道真正的一无所有意味着什么。我们会教你的。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I've lived long enough to see a hundred people like you fail."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我活得够久了，见过上百个像你这样的人失败。”

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ consults an enormous parchment and nods.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@查阅着一大卷羊皮纸，点了点头。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ engages in an animated conversation with the air beside @objective@.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@和@objective@身旁的空气热烈地交谈着。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Orcish loyalty transcends such trifles as death."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“兽人的忠诚超越死亡这类小事。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Take it from an old woman: your time is up."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“听一个老太婆一句劝：你的大限到了。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "You'll be just another bloodstain on the stones of this place."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你只会成为这地方石头上的又一块血迹。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ mutters, "Now, where did I put that quill..."
rows.zh: @The_monster@嘟囔道：“唔，我把那支羽毛笔放哪儿了……”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ mumbles, "Leave me be, @orc name@. I told you I'm busy..."
rows.zh: @The_monster@含混地说：“别烦我，@orc name@。我说过我很忙……”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ mumbles, "Stop that blasted singing, @orc name@. You were always terrible."
rows.zh: @The_monster@含混地说：“别唱那该死的歌了，@orc name@。你一直唱得很难听。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ intently looks at @foe@, slowly moving @possessive@ tail.
rows.zh: @The_monster@目不转睛地盯着@foe@，@possessive@尾巴缓缓摆动。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ stands on @possessive@ hind legs for a moment.
@The_monster@ says, "I'll learn you. I'll learn you yet!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我要教训教训你。我还没教训够呢！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Even if you were a mare, I'd kill you!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“就算你是一匹母马，我也照样杀你！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ shouts, "I'm half human! Half horse! And all stone-cold KILLER!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@喊道：“我一半是人！一半是马！而且是彻头彻尾的冷酷杀手！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Hold still for a moment, will you? I've got a trick shot I want to try here."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你就站着别动一会儿，好吗？我这儿有一记花式箭法想试试。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I schooled the Big Guy. You'll be no problem."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我教训过那大块头。你根本不算什么。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ tries to tell @foe@ a complicated story about hydras, @possessive@ blood, and marriage.
rows.zh: @The_monster@试图给@foe@讲一个复杂的故事，关于九头蛇、@possessive@的血，以及婚姻。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "There's a spark of magic in your eyes."
@The_monster@ raves, "Can you feel it? Can you feel it? CAN YOU FEEL IT?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@胡言乱语道：“你能感觉到吗？你能感觉到吗？你能感觉到吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ warns, "If you see one of my golems, approach with caution, they bite."
rows.zh: @The_monster@警告道：“要是你看到我的魔像，靠近时可要小心，它们会咬人。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "You don't look like a good insulator."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你看起来不像是什么好的绝缘体。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ mumbles, "Hm, I wonder if you're conductive."
rows.zh: @The_monster@嘟囔道：“唔，我很好奇你是不是导体。”
@The_monster@嘶哑地说：“告诉我们……我们……是谁……”
@The_monster@低吼道：“把……我们的名字……还回来！”
@The_monster@喃喃道：“为什么……我们记不起来……？”
@The_monster@嘶哑地说：“现在……你也……谁都不是了。”

rows.raw: the weight of a mountain atop us
rows.zh: 压在我们身上的山岳之重
@The_monster@问道：“你看见我的冲浪板了吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ @_Norris_verb_@, "I think I should really try dying once."
@The_monster@ @_Norris_verb_@ @to_foe@, "Aren't you the least bit curious about what happens next?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@@_Norris_verb_@ @to_foe@：“接下来会发生什么，你就一点都不好奇吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ @_Norris_verb_@ @to_foe@, "The universe is like a big fish."
@The_monster@ @_Norris_verb_@, "Wisdom is knowing when to give up."
@The_monster@ @_Norris_verb_@ @to_foe@, "Only fools fear death. I embrace it."
rows.zh: @The_monster@@_Norris_verb_@ @to_foe@：“只有傻瓜才畏惧死亡。我拥抱死亡。”
@The_monster@@_Norris_verb_@ @to_foe@：“死后你就会找到内心的平静。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ wonders, "Can you step in the same river twice?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@好奇地想：“人能两次踏进同一条河吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Everything is water in the end."

rows.zh: @The_monster@叹息着说 @at_foe@：“开悟真是一种责任啊。”
@The_monster@@_Norris_verb_@ @to_foe@：“让我们一起去喂天上的鲨鱼吧。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I'll see you on the other side, friend."

rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“你会成为一个不错的劣魔。” @player_only@

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "You'll feel the lick of my whip!"
VISUAL:@The_monster@ glares at @foe@ with @possessive@ lone eye.
@The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Trying to escape from me is @_pointless_@!"
VISUAL:@The_monster@ seems to be sizing @foe@ up for @possessive@ next meal.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@似乎正在打量@foe@，好决定@possessive@下一餐吃什么。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ looks around for something heavy to throw at @foe@.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@四下张望，想找点重东西砸@foe@。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ mutters, "When I said I wanted to live forever... this was not what I had in mind."
rows.zh: @The_monster@嘟囔道：“我说想永生的时候……可没想到会是这样。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "At least I didn't end up somewhere with nobody to talk to."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“至少我没落到一个连说话的人都没有的地方。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Come nearer, honey, I don't have a heart of stone."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“再靠近点，亲爱的，我可不是铁石心肠。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ shouts @at_foe@, "I'd kick your ass right now if I could just get over there!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@喊道 @at_foe@：“要是我能挪过去，现在就把你揍趴下！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ prays for a Stone to Flesh spell.
rows.zh: @The_monster@祈祷着能有一个化石为肉的法术。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ wonders, "Maybe oil would work? Probably not."
rows.zh: @The_monster@想道：“也许抹点油管用？大概不管用。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ states @to_foe@, "You'll be worm food in some minutes, I'll endure [millennia|aeons]."
rows.zh: @The_monster@声明道 @to_foe@：“过几分钟你就会变成虫子的食物，而我还能撑[千年|万古]。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "A mighty warrior you might be, a mason you are not!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“你或许是个强大的战士，但绝不是个石匠！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "They said I was crazy for my new talisman... Turns out they were right."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“他们都说我给新护身符迷了心窍……结果他们是对的。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ shouts @at_foe@, "You dare challenge my right as the Messiah?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@喊道 @at_foe@：“你竟敢质疑我作为弥赛亚的资格？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ shouts @at_foe@, "There can only be one messiah: ME!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@喊道 @at_foe@：“弥赛亚只能有一个：那就是我！”
@The_monster@绝望地喊道 @at_foe@：“这里到处都是假先知！”

rows.raw: VISUAL:A flash of anger passes briefly over @the_monster_possessive@ face.
