VISUAL:@The_monster@ draws @possessive@ long claws delicately across @possessive@ gut.
@The_monster@ remarks @to_foe@, "Ah, I could eat a centaur!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说道 @to_foe@：“啊，我能吃下一整只半人马！”
@the_monster@周围的空气短暂地噼啪作响。

rows.raw: VISUAL:A brief shower of sparks shoots from @the_monster_possessive@ claws.
@The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "This battle is not even a challenge!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“这场战斗根本算不上挑战！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ sneers @at_foe@, "There are one thousand and one flaws in your strategy!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@讥笑道 @at_foe@：“你的战术有一千零一个破绽！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Like a bolt from the blue, I'll bring death to you."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我会像晴天霹雳一般，把死亡带给你。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Appear weak when you are strong, and strong when you are weak."
@The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Know thy enemy, and know thyself."
@The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Let your plans be as dark and impenetrable as the night."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“让你的计划像黑夜一样幽暗而深不可测。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "All warfare is based on deception."
@The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "The wise warrior avoids unnecessary battles."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“明智的战士会避开不必要的战斗。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "The whole secret lies in confusing the enemy."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“全部的秘诀在于迷惑敌人。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Avoid what is strong, and strike at what is weak."
@The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Attack is the secret of defence."
@The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "The expert in battle moves the enemy, and is not moved by them."
@The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Appear where you are not expected."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“出现在敌人意想不到的地方。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Ponder and deliberate before you make a move."
@The_monster@ says, "The outcome was never in doubt."
@The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "The Royal Ballet doesn't accept kobolds. That's why I went into killing people."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“皇家芭蕾舞团不收狗头人。所以我才干起了杀人的行当。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "If only old Madame Brzewit could see me now!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“要是老布热维特夫人现在能看到我就好了！”
@The_monster@喊道 @at_foe@：“你这舞伴可真够差劲的！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Someone hired me to kill you, but I'm not supposed to say who."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“有人雇我来杀你，但我不该说是谁。”

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ makes some cryptic hand gestures, then points @at_foe@.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@做了几个神秘的手势，然后指向 @at_foe@。

rows.raw: VISUAL:Space seems to twist oddly around @the_monster@.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@the_monster@周围的空间似乎在古怪地扭曲。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ looks @foe@ over, as though planning @possessive@ next attack.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@打量着@foe@，仿佛在盘算@possessive@下一次攻击。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ glares at @possessive@ squad, motioning for silence.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@瞪了@possessive@小队一眼，示意他们安静。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Hold still for a moment. You're making this shot difficult."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“站着别动。你害得这一箭不好射。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "You are a traitor to our kind!"
@The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Swear allegiance to our queen and you may yet be spared!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“宣誓效忠我们的女王，你或许还能保全性命！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "We do not look kindly on intruders!"
@The_monster@ says to @possessive@ squad, "Do not let the @foe_genus@ escape!"
@The_monster@ says, "All clear. Let's check for more."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“一切安全。再查查还有没有别的。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ mutters, "Wee kobolds think thay ken whit a cannon is."
rows.zh: @The_monster@嘟囔道：“小不点狗头人还以为自己懂什么叫火炮。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ growls, "I'll break a bone for every stich ye rip."
rows.zh: @The_monster@低吼道：“你每撕破一个针脚，俺就打断你一根骨头。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ mumbles, "If ye must ken, mah gran stiched it fur me."
rows.zh: @The_monster@咕哝道：“非要知道的话，这是俺奶奶给俺缝的。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ sings a few bars of a dwarven mine shanty. Very poorly.
rows.zh: @The_monster@唱了几句矮人矿工号子。唱得很差。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I havnae been down this way for yonks. They've redecorated."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“俺好久没走这条路了。他们重新装修过了。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I hear the Orcs make a nippy scran these days."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“听说如今兽人做的吃食挺够味。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ ponders what role @player_genus_plural@ play in the local ecosystem.
rows.zh: @The_monster@思索着@player_genus_plural@在本地生态系统中扮演什么角色。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I'll be sure to include this battle in my report!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我一定要把这场战斗写进报告里！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "We all must contribute to the advancement of science."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我们都必须为科学的进步出力。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ shouts @to_foe@, "You're giving me such wonderful data!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@喊道 @to_foe@：“你给我提供了多么精彩的数据！”

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ furiously scribbles notes with a free limb.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@用一条空着的肢体飞快地记着笔记。

rows.raw: Strange mechanisms whir as @the_monster@ focuses on @foe@.
rows.zh: 奇怪的机械装置嗡嗡作响，@the_monster@全神贯注地盯着@foe@。

rows.raw: VISUAL:A stray blade cuts @the_monster_possessive@ own flesh. @Subjective@ ignores it.
rows.zh: VISUAL:一片乱飞的刀刃割伤了@the_monster_possessive@血肉。@Subjective@对此毫不在意。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ howls @at_foe@, "I'll flense you until there's nothing left!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@嚎叫道 @at_foe@：“我要把你削到一点都不剩！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ screams, "I nearly understand... Get out of my way!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@尖叫道：“我快要弄明白了……别挡我的路！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Look what I've done to myself! Think you can do worse?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“看看我把自己变成了什么样！你觉得你能做得更狠吗？”
@The_monster@大笑道 @at_foe@：“你觉得你比我更锋利吗？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ scoffs, "How can you challenge a perfect, immortal machine?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@嗤笑道：“你凭什么挑战一台完美而不朽的机器？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ wonders, "When I cut you open, what secrets will I find?"
rows.zh: @The_monster@想道：“把你剖开时，我会发现什么秘密呢？”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ mutters, "I can hear her whispering... but she's dead. She's dead!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@嘟囔道：“我能听到她在低语……可她已经死了。她死了！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I'll bring them back. Then they'll show me... everything..."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我会把他们带回来。然后他们就会让我看到……一切……”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "Just more dross for the fire."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“火里不过又多些渣滓罢了。”
@The_monster@说：“来看看你肚子里装了些什么。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ vanishes in a satisfied sigh of withering leaves.
rows.zh: @The_monster@在一阵枯叶的满足叹息中消失了。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ renews @reflexive@ in a burst of flame!
VISUAL:@The_monster@, emptied of spiritual energy, fades out from this realm.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@的灵魂能量被抽空，从这片领域中消散了。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ grows dozens of eye stalks in order to get a better look at @foe@.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@长出几十根眼柄，好把@foe@看得更清楚。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ splatters into many small globs of multi-coloured light, then recombines.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@炸裂成许多多彩的小光团，随后又聚合起来。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ briefly grows a face disturbingly similar to your own.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@短暂地长出一张与你惊人相似的脸。
@The_monster@用@possessive@众多嘴巴发出令人毛骨悚然的嚎叫。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ gibbers incoherently in a cacophony of voices.
rows.zh: @The_monster@用一片嘈杂的嗓音含混不清地胡言乱语。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ stomps with a crash on the @surface@.
VISUAL:@The_monster@ rams the @surface@ with @possessive@ head heavily.
VISUAL:@The_monster@ shines with the incandescence of long-dead nights.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@闪耀着早已死去的夜晚的光辉。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ glitters, immutable and inevitable, in the dim dungeon light.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@在昏暗的地牢光线下闪闪发亮，不可更改，无可避免。

rows.raw: VISUAL:You see your fractured reflection in @the_monster@ contort and writhe. @player_only@
rows.zh: VISUAL:你看见自己支离破碎的倒影在@the_monster@表面扭曲翻腾。 @player_only@

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ glitters chillingly in the dim dungeon light.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@在昏暗的地牢光线下闪着寒气逼人的光。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ begins to take a bow, but slips on a banana peel.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@正要鞠躬，却踩到香蕉皮滑了一跤。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ begins to tie you into a balloon animal.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@开始把你扭成一只气球动物。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ @_laughs_@ at the inevitable fate of oblivion.
rows.zh: @The_monster@@_laughs_@着，笑那无可避免的湮灭命运。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ @_laughs_@ at how history will forget everyone present.
rows.zh: @The_monster@@_laughs_@着，笑历史将如何遗忘在场的每一个人。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ @_laughs_@ at the Dungeon's lack of mercy or dignity.
rows.zh: @The_monster@@_laughs_@着，笑地牢既无怜悯，也无尊严。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ @_laughs_@ at the inescapable nature of violence.
@The_monster@ crumbles to pieces from sheer joy.
VISUAL:@The_monster@ flits into the dungeon's darkness for a moment.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@倏地飞进地牢的黑暗之中，停留了片刻。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ slips into the dungeon's darkness for a moment.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@悄然滑入地牢的黑暗之中，停留了片刻。
VISUAL:@The_monster@没有嘴唇，却露出了微笑。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Everyone has to die sometime, and your time is now."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“人终有一死，而你的时限就是现在。”

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ draws a finger across @possessive@ throat.
VISUAL:@The_monster@ gestures at you to be quiet.
VISUAL:@The_monster@ flutters as if in a wind.
VISUAL:@The_monster@ stares at you with @possessive@ ghostly eyes.
VISUAL:@The_monster@ fades in and out of visibility.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@在可见与不可见之间时隐时现。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "I am all your nightmares come true."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“我是你所有噩梦成真的样子。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "I will drown you in your own blood."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“我要用你自己的血把你淹死。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "I know a thousand and one ways to kill you."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“我有一千零一种杀死你的办法。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "I'll show you my torture chamber!"
@The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Get ready! Throes of agony await you."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“准备好吧！痛苦的挣扎等着你。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ shouts @at_foe@, "Prepare for my thousand needles of pain!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@喊道 @at_foe@：“准备承受我的千根痛针！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ @_weeps_@ over the unstoppable march of time and entropy.
rows.zh: @The_monster@为时间与熵不可阻挡的行进@_weeps_@。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ asks how much longer can this world bear the weight of past lives.
rows.zh: @The_monster@发问：这个世界还能背负逝去生命的重量多久。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ mourns the many lost in the orcish exodus to the Dungeon.
rows.zh: @The_monster@为兽人大迁徙中在地牢里丧生的众多亡者哀悼。

rows.raw:
@The_monster@ intones a prayer.
VISUAL:A sense of peace washes over you.
rows.zh:
@The_monster@吟诵着祈祷文。
VISUAL:一种宁静的感觉涌上你心头。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Thou must remain pure in the battle against evil."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“在与邪恶作战时，你必须保持纯洁。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Praised be @_good_god_@ in the heavens above!"
@The_monster@ @_loudly_or_repeatedly_@ @_shouts_@ encouragement to no one in particular.
@The_monster@ sings a few bars from the Orcish anthem.
@The_monster@ @_orc_says_to_foe_@, "Beogh doesn't tell me what to do!"

rows.zh: @The_monster@@_orc_says_to_foe_@：“比欧弗的弥赛亚只是个童话。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says @to_foe@, "Even if there were a messiah, it wouldn't be you."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说 @to_foe@：“就算真有弥赛亚，那也绝不会是你。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ @_says_or_shouts_@, "I am so glad I met you."
@The_monster@ @_orc_says_@, "A dead @_orc_heathen_@ will not bedevil my soul."
@The_monster@ says, "I never had a vision before."

rows.zh: @The_monster@@_says_or_shouts_@：“我们倒下的同胞不会被遗忘。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ looks @at_foe@ and says, "I'd rather not die in your service, @player_name@."
rows.zh: @The_monster@看着 @at_foe@说：“我宁愿不要为效忠你而死，@player_name@。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ chants, "I shall fear no evil, for @player_name@ is my saviour."
rows.zh: @The_monster@吟唱道：“我必不惧怕邪恶，因为@player_name@是我的救主。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ says, "I'm proud to be an orc."
@The_monster@ says, "I'm an Orc, you're an Orc, it's OK."
rows.zh: @The_monster@说：“我是兽人，你是兽人，一切都好。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ seems like @subjective@ is about to say something to you, then stops.
rows.zh: @The_monster@似乎@subjective@正要对你说些什么，却又停住了。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ @_mutters_@, "When this is all over, I'm going to start a fungus farm."
rows.zh: @The_monster@@_mutters_@：“等这一切结束，我要去开个真菌农场。”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ stares at you in amazement and kneels.
@The_monster@ relaxes @possessive@ fighting stance and smiles at you.
@Subjective@ shouts, "You have your revenge! Let me go!"
rows.zh: @Subjective@喊道：“你的仇已经报了！放我走！”

rows.raw: @Subjective@ shouts, "Spare me, and you'll never see me again!"
rows.zh: @Subjective@喊道：“饶了我，你再也见不到我！”

rows.raw: @Subjective@ says, "I deserve death, but Beogh is merciful!"
rows.zh: @Subjective@说：“我该死，可比欧弗是慈悲的！”

rows.raw: The priest shouts, "Disloyal scoundrel, leave my sight!"
rows.zh: 祭司喊道：“不忠的恶棍，滚出我的视线！”

rows.raw: The priest snarls, "I'll spare you only if you run away! Begone!"
rows.zh: 祭司龇牙道：“你若逃跑，我倒是可以饶你一命！滚吧！”

rows.raw: The priest curses, "Your faithless show of piety disgusts me!"
rows.zh: 祭司咒骂道：“你这不虔的伪善模样让我恶心！”

rows.raw: The priest sneers, "Beogh may forgive you, but I don't!"
rows.zh: 祭司讥笑道：“比欧弗或许会原谅你，我可不会！”

rows.raw: The priest shouts, "You had your chance, apostate scum!"
rows.zh: 祭司喊道：“机会已经给过你了，叛教的渣滓！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ shouts, "I yield! You are indeed the chosen one!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@喊道：“我投降！你确实是天选之人！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ cries, "Kill them all! Beogh will know Beogh's own!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@大喊道：“把他们全杀了！比欧弗认得出谁是自己人！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ beats @possessive@ weapon against @possessive@ chest and roars.
@The_monster@ cries out, "For our kin! And for all that died before them!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@喊道：“为了我们的同胞！也为了所有先他们而死的人！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ smears @possessive@ weapon with vermillion and lifts it high.
rows.zh: @The_monster@用朱红的鲜血涂抹@possessive@武器，将它高高举起。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ shouts, "Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, life for life!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@喊道：“以眼还眼，以牙还牙，以命偿命！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ cries, "Return their pain upon them a hundredfold!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@喊道：“把他们的痛苦百倍奉还！”

rows.raw: keeping your body clean and pure.
proper care of body and soul.

rows.zh: 不用[护身符|小饰物]改变身体。
避开一切[护身符|小饰物]。

rows.raw: mutations, and how to avoid them.
rows.zh: 变异，以及如何避免变异。

rows.raw: potions of mutation - the devil's brew!
neqoxecs and zykzyls - may they all be destroyed!
rows.zh: 奈库塞克与兹克兹尔——愿它们全被消灭！

rows.raw: a proper diet respecting intelligent beings.
rows.zh: 尊重智慧生物的适当饮食。

rows.raw: undead, and why they are evil.
rows.zh: 亡灵，以及它们为何邪恶。
伊莱德莱姆努尔的堕落。

rows.raw: the alliance of Zin and the Shining One.
the alliance of Zin and Elyvilon.
@The_monster@ stares @at_foe@, then turns away, jangling a coin purse.
rows.zh: @The_monster@盯着 @at_foe@，然后转过身去，晃了晃钱袋。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ grins @at_foe@ greedily, jangling a coin purse.
rows.zh: @The_monster@贪婪地咧嘴一笑 @at_foe@，晃了晃钱袋。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ waves a pennant with your name on it.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@挥舞着一面写着你的名字的三角旗。

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster@ waves a pennant, rooting for your enemy!
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@挥舞着三角旗，为你的敌人加油！

rows.raw: VISUAL:@The_monster_possessive@ armour gleams in the torchlight.
VISUAL:@The_monster@, chosen of Okawaru, glows resplendent with favour.
rows.zh: VISUAL:@The_monster@，奥卡瓦鲁的选民，因恩宠而容光焕发。

rows.raw: @The_monster@ draws Degeneration. "So many ways to mutate things!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@抽到了退化。“让东西变异的方法可真多！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ draws the Orb. "Orbs of destruction hurt!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@抽到了宝珠。“毁灭宝珠可疼了！”
@The_monster@抽到了痛苦。“死灵法术可疼了！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ draws the Storm. "Thunder and lightning everywhere!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@抽到了风暴。“到处都是电闪雷鸣！”

rows.raw: @The_monster@ draws Wild Magic. "So many ways magic can go wrong!"
rows.zh: @The_monster@抽到了狂野魔法。“魔法出错的方式可真多！”
